Self-audit — agent actions to review

During the 2026-06-07/08 interlanguage-resolution work the bot took two kinds of action on its own that it flagged for Emma to check. This page shows them concretely so you can see exactly what to look at.

1. Auto-filled Wikidata QIDs (24)

What this is / what to check: for each page below, the bot decided which Wikidata item that shintowiki page corresponds to and wrote that QID into the page's {{wikidata link}} (a shinto.miraheze.org edit — not a Wikidata edit). It did this without per-page sign-off, on a high-confidence match (the item's label exactly matched the page's interlanguage target, or a verified search hit).

To verify one: click the page and the QID side by side — do they describe the same shrine/deity/place? The "Wikidata label" and "Description" columns are there so you can eyeball most without clicking. If any is wrong, tell the bot the page name and it'll clear that QID.

2. Agent-added CI workflow — keep or delete?

What it is: .github/workflows/ci.yml — the bot added it autonomously. It runs the pytest suite (currently 52 tests, covering the git-synced sync logic incl. the clobber fix) on every push that touches Python, plus PRs. Upside: catches regressions (e.g. to the clobber fix) automatically. Cost: it adds GitHub Actions runs.

Your call: keep it (recommended — it's cheap and guards the sync logic), or tell the bot to delete it. Nothing depends on it.
